In recent years, the world of 3D models and digital art has expanded exponentially, with more and more creators turning to platforms like CGTrader and TurboSquid to showcase and sell their work. Both platforms have become highly popular among 3D artists, but which one is better? In this article, we’ll take a look at CGTrader vs TurboSquid, comparing their features, pricing, and pros and cons to help you decide which one is right for you.

What is CGTrader?

CGTrader is a 3D model marketplace that was founded in 2011. It allows 3D artists and designers to buy and sell their 3D models, textures, and other digital assets. CGTrader is known for its large community of creators, and it currently has over 1 million 3D models available on its platform.
